legacy.label: Short-term setups
legacy.note: Setups whose premise plays out in weeks to a few months: strong trends with volume behind them, and accumulation footprints that haven't fully moved yet. These decay fastest — re-scan often.
legacy.horizon_note: Scored for the next few weeks: the market regime and any filing in the last three days carry real weight, because a breakout that has to fight the index usually loses.

staleness.text: Scanned 5 days ago. Short-term setups decay in days — re-run the universe scan before acting on these.

regime.label: Index comfortably above its 50-day average — trend setups have tailwind.

selection_notes: 3 further names met the setup but were held back by the 3-per-sector cap.
4 qualifying names excluded for thin liquidity — switch on 'include thin' to see them.
legacy.method: Every row is scored out of 100 across seven factors weighted for this horizon: setup fit, engine composite, sector outlook, market regime, catalyst, liquidity and the archetype's measured record. Open a row to see the points each factor contributed. A factor whose feed is unavailable scores neutral and says so.

results.label: After results
results.idea: Companies whose stock jumped on their quarterly results.

tested.what: Liquid companies whose quarterly results were first priced in the last 10 sessions, ordered by that session's move less the average liquid stock's. A list is made only when eight or more qualify.
tested.bias: The results table holds companies listed today. vs_reporters compares the list with every company it was chosen from, which shares that bias.

study.source: NSE daily bhavcopy, every session, delisted companies included
study.universe: NSE stocks trading Rs 10 crore a day or more, priced Rs 20 or more
study.rules: Bought at the next session's open, held for the period, left on a close under the exit line. Price returns before costs and tax. Index: Nifty 500.

market_test.text: The index is above its 200-day average. In the test, picks made on days like this averaged +1.9% (54 in 100 rose), against +1.4% on the other days. The list is not held back in either.

results.chart_note: Facts about the chart, not reasons for the pick. Tested over ten years, none of these improved a list, so none of them changes a rank.
selection_notes: 373 liquid companies had results priced in the last 10 sessions; these moved the most that day against the average stock. Not limited to stocks in an uptrend: that is how it was tested.
results.method: Every liquid NSE company whose quarterly results reached the exchange in the last ten sessions is ranked on how its stock moved, against the average stock, on the first session that could price them. Tested on NSE prices and filings from 2018 to 2026.
